Clear event stages 25 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 40 times, not including tutorial stages.

list: A makeshift shelf crafted from Salt Flat materials, piled high with various odds and ends. The golden key hanging from it unlocks the treasure vault, where the ship's most valuable possession is stored: Nene's premium saltfin feed.

Exquisitely designed, carefully crafted table topped with specially purchased goblets, wine, and candleholders. 'At the very least, the reception area should show the captain's authority, as well as the strength of our mighty Cuna de Nene'!

Hanging pouch made from saltfin skin—can be unfurled to collect rainwater. It is said the captain once hung upside down from it and did crunches. Rose Salt speculates that he was practicing untying the ropes to escape from the gallows.

An aesthetically pleasing storage cabinet, something rarely seen on salt ships. Crafted by a crew member who aspired to become a carpenter. It is said that he later moved to town and opened his own carpentry shop, and that business is good.

Panoramic display of Mar Pálido. Only the bright red steam stands out from the pale bones and salt. The pirates board their ships to finally leave their ancestral home. They hate the barren desolation, but will always miss their hometown.

This wooden floor, a relic of the Golden Age, remains remarkably sturdy despite its age. The gaps between the floorboards are filled with salt crystals, which could corrode the wood if not cleaned promptly.
Please follow medical instructions for proper use and disposal.
theme: A recreation of the 'Cuna de Nene' Cabin's interior, based on Thorns's description. The Salt Flat may be a barren expanse of white, devoid of life, but inside the cabin, life was always colorful and interesting.

list:
You are a true pirate.
What are the core qualities of a pirate? Having no home to go back to? A scary scarred face with a mouthful of sharp teeth? Or is it just an unwillingness to be trapped by the boundaries of the land?
During the Exodus from the Pale Sea event, obtain Operator Rose Salt

A seal made of bone. It's been clumsily engraved with Pascuala's likeness, along with the words 'Pascuala Empire.'
'You'd better not lose it—if you ever need to do business with the great Señora Pascuala and you don't have the seal, that's on you. I won't be able to help you.'
During the Exodus from the Pale Sea event, consume 2400 Saltfin Garum in the [Salt Ship Marketplace]

You spent so much saltfin garum at the salt ship market that its value began to plummet.
There are drawbacks to treating a drink as a fiat currency. No matter how many goods are for sale, the amount a person can drink is limited... It's just too salty!
Complete all stages in [Across the Salt Flat] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

You've witnessed the journey to the open seas.
People used to ask 'must all Iberians go out to sea?' Now they ask, 'must all Iberians fear the sea?'
Complete all the content in [Sailing Schedule] and collect the rewards

Even in the vast desert, you've maintained your sense of direction.
The Salt Flat is as expansive as the sea of stars. While tallying their harvest on the returning salt ship, the crew tacitly avoids mentioning the next sailing schedule. After all, returning safely from the Flat without getting lost is no small feat, and they deserve to quietly savor their success for a while.
Clear EP-5 with a 3-star rating while making at least 3 enemies sink into the Salt Flat

You've witnessed how the cruel Salt Flat can devour people in the blink of an eye.
Even the most seasoned crew members cannot differentiate between solid, walkable salt crust and the soft, salty quick-sand. The only reliable gauge is whether the person ahead of you is sinking.
Clear EP-EX-1 with a 3-star rating while making at least 5 enemies sink into the Salt Flat

You've witnessed true 'El Dominio del Mar.'
'Fighting the wind and waves' is no mere boast. For a master of this art, the sword serves as a third leg—enabling them to dart agilely between masts. No need to even draw their sword—their enemies will lose their footing and fall overboard on their own.
During the Exodus from the Pale Sea event, defeat a total of at least 50 Garum Gourmets and Rum Gourmets

You've witnessed an astonishing bout of extravagant drinking.
Saltfin garum, fine rum—each bottle in the fleet's stockpiles meets the same fate: untouched for weeks, only to be drained and discarded during a devilish night of debauchery.
Complete all stages in [Through the Skeletal Reef] on Challenge Mode

None of the many hazards in the Salt Flat can deter you.
On the land once swallowed by the sea and later disgorged, an ecosystem unlike any other on Terra has evolved. However, the ones who know this land best are not the ecologists, but a group of displaced souls about to leave it.
Clear EP-8 with a 3-star rating and destroy at least 1 Saltheap Cannon

You blocked the cannon's muzzle just as it was about to fire.
One of the pirates' many secrets: the heaps fired by the Saltheap Cannon are kneaded together with fin droppings. As cannons go, it's fairly weak, but no one wants to be hit with its shrapnel!
set: Exodus from the Pale Sea Engraved Medal Set

An engraved medal set capturing the scene of the pirates of Mar Pálido sailing to the open sea. The wanderers call themselves pirates, but had never seen a drop of seawater in their lives—until just now.
